packet_note: No producer reasoning in the packet. The orchestrator's context line (empty wall, bare table and a separate cup layer are intentional) restates BUILD-SPEC act 1 and the spec's own story_purpose; checked against BUILD-SPEC, and none of the findings below object to the empty areas. The prompt file was not opened (spec mode).

checks.evidence: Every block is present and every line is checkable, and the 1-second moment is a single idea: must_read_in_1s 'A red phone lies quiet on a café table in Tirana at night'. The phone has prop boxes ('phone' [0.52,0.66,0.74,0.86] and 'phone-screen' [0.54,0.68,0.72,0.84]). There are no hands, text or faces to box.

Spec mode: no prompt and no upload order. The notes name one reference ('image 1 STYLE-TOP@v1 (look only; its baked text must not be copied)'). I opened it: the dark wall, the night window and the lit tower, with baked headline and '1/7'.
'hands: none visible' plus must_not 'no hands or fingers'. No prop is held ('held_by: null').
Static, written as contact points: 'the case's back rim touches the wood along all four edges, no edge raised, a thin soft contact shadow hugging its outline'.

PR-PHONE has a full content line: 'a thin raised red case lip runs evenly round the screen, then a very thin black bezel; the screen is one continuous pure black glass rectangle ... all four corners visible and crisp'. The screen is meant to be off because the HTML screen maps onto it (BUILD-SPEC act 1, Screen plane), so the targeted 'no screen content' negative does not empty a needed prop.
'text_in_image: none', with surfaces named: 'no text, letters, numbers or signage on the wall, the window glass, the tower, the facades, the table or the phone (all words on this page are HTML)'.

The window, clock faces, wall and phone screen all have a content rule: 'The opening is filled with the night square and the lit tower, never blank or black ... (the clock faces show hands only)'. The background rule bans 'lamps, sconces, art, frames, shelves, mirrors, posters, plants or chair backs'.

The tower is 'standing in the left part of the opening (about x 0.74 to 0.85 ...)', but the window is 'x 0.62 to 0.98', whose centre is x 0.80. The 0.74 to 0.85 box (region clock-tower [0.73,0.08,0.86,0.58]) is centred in the opening, not in its left part. The visual reviewer would get two criteria that cannot both pass.

'previous_shot: null'. The carry_over ('the dark café wall, the night window with the lit clock tower, the warm tungsten grade'; 'a deep red #BE0F18 case, screen off') matches STYLE-TOP@v1 as opened, the style-bible thread and STYLE@v1. The downstream specs agree: WEB-CUP takes 'the warm tungsten key from upper right of WEB-HERO-D', and WEB-HERO-M uses the same PR-PHONE content line byte for byte.
Spec mode: model rules are checked at G-PROMPT-IMG. Recorded for that gate: notes 'gpt_image_2_5, aspect_ratio 16:9, resolution 2k, quality medium, variant flare'.

Fields that will become prompt text name the area that must stay empty after the object it must not show: 'CUP SPOT: ... nothing on it ... the separate WEB-CUP layer is composited over it later'. The same 'cup spot' label is repeated in action_physics and safe_zones. A model can read 'the cup spot' as the place where the cup is, and the compositing remark as a request to draw the cup.

FL-13: 'no StraightScale mark drawn in any corner (FL-13)'; the nav carries the real logo. FL-02: one structure line for the window ('a single rectangular opening in a thin dark frame with four straight inner edges, no mullions'). FL-05: background rule present. FL-10 and FL-11: no text, and 'no second phone'. STYLE@v1 V22 and V23: 'no crinkled or foil-like tabletop' and 'no borders, side bands, pillarbox strips'. FL-04: content line plus targeted negatives; on the missing prop sheet, see the Director note in suggested_spec_changes.

suggested_spec_changes.to: standing in the middle of the opening (about x 0.74 to 0.85, its axis near x 0.80, inside the central 4:3 area), with the lit square and facades on both sides of it
suggested_spec_changes.why: This matches the box and the clock-tower region. It also matches WEB-EXT, which centres the tower and is what shows through the keyed opening. If the tower really should sit left, move the box and the region instead (for example x 0.66 to 0.77) and keep it inside x 0.125 to 0.875.

suggested_spec_changes.check: P12 (Director note, not counted as a FAIL)
suggested_spec_changes.note: VISUAL-QA 4.4 step 1 and the FL-04 prevention ask for a prop sheet for every story-critical prop, attached wherever the prop appears. PR-PHONE has none. The ref string ('design source only, not attached') satisfies the lint without meeting the rule. I did not count this as a FAIL for three reasons: the spec documents why (STYLE@v1 failed G-VIS-SHEET); the phone's required state is screen off, so FL-04's 'comes back blank' pattern does not apply; and WEB-HERO-D and WEB-HERO-M use the same content line. Waiving the sheet, or making a PR-PHONE prop sheet first, is the Director's decision.
